title: Backupify: Backup & Restore
summary: Protect photos, videos, contacts, messages and files securely.
description:
Backupify: Backup & Restore helps you protect important data with secure cloud backup and easy restore tools. Back up photos, videos, contacts, SMS messages, call logs, calendar events, documents, downloads, audio files, WhatsApp media, installed apps, APK files, and more from one simple app.

Sign in with your Google account and access your backups securely from anywhere.

Whether you're switching phones, recovering after a reset, or keeping data safe, Backupify makes backup and restore simple and reliable.

BACK UP YOUR DATA

✓ Photos & Videos

Photo backup and video backup.

✓ Contacts

Contact backup and restore.

✓ SMS & MMS

SMS backup and restore.

✓ Call Logs

Call log backup and restore.

✓ Calendar Events

Calendar backup and restore.

✓ Documents & Files

Back up documents, downloads, APK files, archives, and other supported files.

✓ Audio Files

Back up music and recordings.

✓ WhatsApp Media

Back up WhatsApp photos, videos, audio, and documents.

✓ Installed Apps & APK Backup

Back up installed apps and APK files and restore supported apps when needed.

BACKUP FEATURES

• One-Tap Backup All (Premium)

• Category-based backup

• Backup size estimation

• Background backup

• Real-time progress

• Backup notifications

• Pause and resume

• Backup history

• Upload only new photos

RESTORE FEATURES

• Full Restore (Premium)

• Category-based restore

• Restore photos, videos, contacts, SMS, call logs, calendar events, files, and apps

AUTOMATIC BACKUPS

• Daily, weekly, or monthly schedules

• Wi-Fi only option

• Automatic resume on network recovery

AI INSIGHTS

• Smart backup recommendations

• Backup health score

PREMIUM FEATURES

• Backup All

• Full Restore

• Scheduled Auto Backup

• Ad-Free Experience

• Dark Theme

BACKGROUND OPERATIONS

Backupify uses foreground services for user-initiated backup and restore operations with progress notifications.

PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS

Permissions are requested only for selected backup and restore features.

Depending on the categories you choose, permissions may be required for photos, videos, audio, files, contacts, SMS messages, call logs, calendar events, storage, and installed apps.

File access is used only to locate, back up, restore, import, or export user-selected content.

Installed app visibility is used only for Installed Apps Backup & Restore.

You remain in control of your data and can delete backups at any time.

IMPORTANT

Features may vary depending on Android version, device manufacturer restrictions, permissions, and system limitations.

Download Backupify today and keep your photos, videos, contacts, SMS messages, call logs, calendar events, installed apps, APK files, and important files protected with secure cloud backup and restore.
